nodes.name: .oxlintrc.json
nodes.summary: Oxlint linter configuration for the monorepo: enables type-aware linting, warns on the suspicious category, and disables rules that clash with Effect generator closures, SolidJS reactive patterns, and namespace-heavy code.
nodes.languageNotes: Oxlint tolerates JSONC: this file contains inline comments and three duplicate top-level `options` keys without erroring.

nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Canonical workspace instruction file for AI coding agents, covering the fork's monorepo layout, setup, style guide, testing and typecheck rules, plus an extensive catalog of known issues and architectural notes. Re-read from disk and injected as a user message on every LLM API call.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the AGENTS.md convention (Instruction Hierarchy pattern) rather than a CLAUDE.md; documentation-integrity rules require file:line anchors to be re-verified before edits propagate into agent behavior.

nodes.name: CHANGELOG.md
nodes.summary: Keep-a-changelog style log of unreleased changes in this fork, grouping Added, Changed, Fixed, and Security entries with links to individual commits.

nodes.name: CONTRIBUTING.md
nodes.summary: Contributor guide covering local development workflows (dev server, API server, web and desktop apps, debugger setup), pull request expectations and style preferences, feature request policy, and the trust and vouch system for external contributors.

nodes.name: GEMINI.md
nodes.summary: Empty zero-byte placeholder that marks the repo root for the Gemini CLI instruction-file convention; carries no instructions itself (AGENTS.md remains the canonical agent instructions).

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Project front page for the open source AI coding agent: installation across package managers, desktop app beta notes, agent and keybinding overview, and FAQ, with links to 20+ translated README variants.

nodes.name: SECURITY.md
nodes.summary: Security policy defining the project's threat model (no sandbox, server mode exposure caveats, out-of-scope items) and the process for reporting vulnerabilities with escalation contacts.

nodes.name: STATS.md
nodes.summary: Single large markdown table tracking daily GitHub and npm download counts with per-day deltas and running totals since mid-2025; pure data record with no narrative sections.

nodes.name: ai-sdk-updates.md
nodes.summary: Dependency upgrade report for the Vercel AI SDK family (ai, @ai-sdk/anthropic, gateway, groq, xai, perplexity, bedrock, google-vertex), summarizing available minor/patch bumps, transitive-only changes, and a suggested upgrade order.

nodes.name: bunfig.toml
nodes.summary: Bun runtime configuration pinning exact versions on install and pointing the test runner root at a guard path, enforcing the 'do not run tests from root' rule so tests must run from package directories.

nodes.name: other-package-updates.md
nodes.summary: Minor/patch upgrade report for non-AI-SDK dependencies, bucketing candidates into safe upgrades, high-impact fixes, items needing review, already-latest, and out-of-scope major bumps, ending with a recommended upgrade order.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Root manifest of the Bun workspace monorepo: defines workspace globs (packages/*, packages/sdk/js), the centralized dependency version catalog, monorepo-wide scripts (dev, lint, typecheck), patched dependencies, trusted dependencies, and prettier settings.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Bun's `catalog:` protocol so workspace packages share pinned versions via bun.lock, plus `patchedDependencies` mapping four upstream packages to patch files under patches/.

nodes.name: plan-opencode-memory-reduction-2026-08-02.md
nodes.summary: Turkish-language optimization plan for reducing the opencode main process memory footprint, analyzing the eagerly loaded models-snapshot (~50-100 MB), ONNX embeddings (~15-20 MB), and growing LSP diagnostic maps, with lazy-loading and cleanup proposals, measurement methodology, and rollback notes.

nodes.name: subagent-effect-trypromise-report.md
nodes.summary: Turkish-language root-cause analysis of Effect.tryPromise failures in the write/edit tools, tracing the error through createTwoFilesPatch, diff-wasm WASM initialization races, and error masking by Effect.orDie, with five proposed fixes and step-by-step verification instructions.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: Root TypeScript configuration extending @tsconfig/bun defaults and excluding the plugins directory; compiler options are deliberately empty because each workspace package owns its own tsconfig.

nodes.name: turbo.json
nodes.summary: Turborepo task pipeline for the monorepo defining typecheck, build, and test/test:ci tasks with per-package overrides for opencode, @opencode-ai/app, and @opencode-ai/ui, including JUnit artifact outputs and environment passthrough.
nodes.languageNotes: Package-scoped task overrides use the `<package>#<task>` key syntax (e.g. `opencode#test`, `@opencode-ai/app#test:ci`).
